verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed that register.dpma.de serves a real robots.txt (HTTP 200) with explicit directives: 'Disallow: /' for all agents plus enumerated Allow paths. An agent can therefore learn what it may read before fetching, even though the policy is restrictive. Missing for 10: evidence of a robots.txt on the main www.dpma.de and DEPATISnet hosts, first-party documentation of the crawl policy, and clarity on whether the Allow paths cover the search surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
